## Components

27 declared across 3 design(s).

| Component | Name | Responsibility | Introduced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acquisition-runner` | Acquisition runner | Claims a run request and drives acquisition instrument by instrument, isolating per-instrument failure | `CAP-001` |
| `coverage-service` | Coverage service | Derives per-instrument coverage and last-acquired dates, and detects gaps in daily prices against the trading-day set formed from all named instruments' observed dates | `CAP-001` |
| `ingestion-api` | Ingestion JSON API | FastAPI surface serving the interface; the only network entry point | `CAP-001` |
| `instrument-list-service` | Instrument list service | Maintains the owner's instrument list, each entry active or retired, and the history depth setting | `CAP-001` |
| `market-data-store` | Market data store | The PostgreSQL schema holding instruments, observations, coverage segments and run records | `CAP-001` |
| `massive-client` | Massive client | Hand-written HTTP client for Massive reference, aggregate, fundamental and corporate-action reads | `CAP-001` |
| `observation-writer` | Observation writer | Appends observations point-in-time with the observation date and extends coverage segments in the same transaction | `CAP-001` |
| `owner-web-app` | Owner interface | React SPA presenting the instrument list, coverage, gaps, run history and failure detail | `CAP-001` |
| `rate-limit-governor` | Rate limit governor | Paces provider requests to the configured budget, waits out rate limiting as flow control, and applies bounded exponential backoff to transport and server errors | `CAP-001` |
| `run-journal` | Run journal | Owns the acquisition run record and its lifecycle — requested, running, cancelling, succeeded, partial, failed, cancelled, abandoned — including cancellation requests and reclaim of runs whose runner died | `CAP-001` |
| `runtime-config` | Runtime configuration | Loads and validates configuration and the provider credential from the environment; redacts secrets; owns the deployment definition (`Dockerfile`, `compose.yaml`, `.dockerignore`) | `CAP-001` |
| `schema-migrator` | Schema migrator | Applies numbered forward-only SQL migrations and maintains `applied_migrations | `CAP-001` |
| `classification-api` | Classification JSON API | FastAPI routers for `/api/universes` and `/api/classifications`, registered on the application the ingestion API factory builds and therefore behind its request-id, Host and Origin middleware and error envelope | `CAP-002` |
| `classification-reader` | Classification reader | Read side of classification: resolves the current set and its currency, serves sorted and threshold-filtered lists over all classified stocks or one universe with keyset pagination and a full-set match count, side-by-side comparison of 2 to 6 stocks, per-stock evidence with current universe memberships, classification history, and a set summary with per-factor counts and the current-stock count | `CAP-002` |
| `classification-scheduler` | Classification scheduler | Asyncio loop in the application container that polls the run journal table for a succeeded or partial run without a classification set, creates the set, drives the factor engine off the event loop, records failure with its reason, and enforces one building set at a time | `CAP-002` |
| `classification-ui` | Classification interface | React screens and fetch layer for the Research area of the product UX blueprint: the screener-and-inspector screen S03 at `/research` (filters pane, virtualised results table with selection tray, inspector, not-current banner) and the stock evidence, compare and universes pages at `/research/stocks/:symbol`, `/research/compare?symbols=`, `/research/universes` and `/research/universes/:universeId`, mounted in the owner interface shell as client routes behind the single Research rail destination; filter, sort and scope state lives in the URL query. User-visible labels follow STD-UI-1 v6 and blueprint §7 (*stock*, *download*, *Incomplete*, *Not enough to rank*, *percentile*, *standardised score*); the API keeps the domain terms | `CAP-002` |
| `factor-engine` | Factor engine | Builds one classification set for one qualifying acquisition run: derives every factor input with its known-on date, decides present, missing, outdated or not computable per input, forms each factor's peer set, computes standardised scores and percentiles with SQL window functions, marks possible restatement, and appends the results | `CAP-002` |
| `research-store` | Research store | The PostgreSQL schema additions holding universes and their event log, classification sets, per-set factor counts, factor inputs and factor classifications; append-only history applied by numbered migrations `0005` onward | `CAP-002` |
| `universe-service` | Universe service | Creates, renames and retires universes and adds or removes members by appending events to the universe event log; derives current and as-of membership by replay; refuses empty universes, last-member removal and stocks acquisition does not cover; takes the server-side filter snapshot | `CAP-002` |
| `command-palette` | Command palette | The `command` `dialog` opened by the shell: Stocks from the followed list (server prefix search), Universes and Pages filtered locally, targets per DEC-0207; never a trading action. `web/src/app/command-palette/ | `CAP-003` |
| `data-health-api` | Data health JSON API | FastAPI router serving `GET /api/attention`, `GET /api/data-health` and `GET /api/data-health/problems`, registered on the application `ingestion-api` builds and therefore behind its request-id, Host and Origin middleware and error envelope. `src/factorflow/api/routes/data_health.py | `CAP-003` |
| `data-health-reader` | Data health reader | Read-only Python module computing the problem-stock set, the latest and latest-terminal downloads with progress, the followed count, the prices as-of, the server-derived attention items, the verdict counts and the Daily prices and Company financials checks (DEC-0200, DEC-0201). `src/factorflow/data_health/ | `CAP-003` |
| `data-health-ui` | Data health screen | S09 M1 regions at `/data`: verdict, Daily prices, Company financials and Factor scores cards, *Needs fixing* with its recoveries, Recent downloads, What you follow | `CAP-003` |
| `home-ui` | Home screen | S01 M1 regions at `/home`: date and market state (DEC-0206), the data tile, and the *Needs you* list merged from the attention items and the score-derived items (DEC-0203) | `CAP-003` |
| `owner-shell` | Owner interface shell | React composition root of the owner interface: the rail in two groups listing only shipped destinations with their attention counts, the sticky top bar with the route-derived title and the palette button, the route map with the `/` redirect and the four legacy redirects, the unreachable state, and the shell-wide polled reads (health 30 s; attention and classification summary 60 s, 10 s while a download is non-terminal or scores are building) shared through the shell context. Replaces the delivered shell and route composition in `web/src/app/` (DEC-0204) | `CAP-003` |
| `setup-ui` | Setup screen | S02 steps 1 to 4 at `/setup`: stepper, per-step drafts held for the visit, each step committed through the delivered endpoints, the first download started and its progress shown (DEC-0202) | `CAP-003` |
| `ui-components` | Design-system components and shared patterns | The design-system components vendored as shadcn/ui ships them in `web/src/components/ui/` (badge, button, card, data-table, dialog, input, textarea, select, checkbox, radio-group, progress, stepper, command, toast) and the blueprint §4 patterns in `web/src/components/patterns/` (Needs-you item and `sortAttention`, as-of line, status badge with tier shape, state-coverage region), consuming only `theme.css` tokens (DEC-0205) | `CAP-003` |

## Findings

### Interfaces naming an undeclared component

The component may not be designed yet, in which case the interface is
specified against something that does not exist and the gap belongs in
that design's open questions.

| Interface | Role | Reference | Declared by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Provider reads` | provider | `Massive REST API (external)` | `CAP-001` |
| `GET /api/classifications/summary` | consumer | `classification-ui`; `shell-home-and-data-health-ui (unpublished)` — see Section 8, question 10` | `CAP-002` |

### Components on no interface

Neither providing nor consuming anything across a boundary. Often
correct for an internal component; worth a look when it is not.

| Component | Introduced by |
|---|---|
| `instrument-list-service` | `CAP-001` |
| `rate-limit-governor` | `CAP-001` |
| `runtime-config` | `CAP-001` |
